cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - DoubleFlexDoorBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with two part lid with living hinges and round corners
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DoubleFlexDoorBox --x 140 --y 60 --h 90 --radius 0 --outside 0 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes DoubleFlexDoorBox --x --y --h --radius --outside --reference
